The `.env.example` file in the `python-backend` codebase provides a template for environment variables related to AWS, NGROK, Auth0, PostgreSQL, OpenAI, and Modal configurations.

# Purpose
This file is an environment configuration file that stores sensitive credentials and configuration details for various services used in a software application. It includes placeholders for AWS credentials and region, Ngrok API key, Auth0 authentication details, PostgreSQL database credentials, an OpenAI API key, and Modal token information. These values are typically set in a secure manner to enable the application to authenticate and interact with these external services.
